title: NIAID defined term
description: A schema:DefinedTerm with NIAID's annotations. The NIAID Data Discovery Portal annotates every term it attaches to a dataset (species, infectious agents, health conditions, measurement techniques, variables): whether a curator checked it, the text it was matched from, who or what curated it, and for a taxon its common name. Across the portal's records these properties appear on DefinedTerms and nowhere else, so this block is an extension of that type and requires it.

allOf.description: A defined term, or a reference to one. It must name or identify the term.

nde:isCurated.description: Whether a curator checked the term against its source text.

nde:originalName.description: The text in the source record the term was matched from.

nde:curatedBy.description: Who or what produced or checked the annotation, often software (PubTator, GPT-4o-mini, the Biothings API).

cdifniaid:commonName.description: The common name of a taxon, e.g. Human for Homo sapiens.
